chapters.label: The final, live
chapters.text: Kansas City, 2024, the NWSL final. Orlando Pride against Washington Spirit. Angelina plays it forward. Barbra Banda surges down the right wing, cuts inside... and smashes it in!

chapters.label: The surge
chapters.text: Watch again. Banda is strong and fast. She races away from her defender and cuts in onto her left foot.

chapters.label: The strike
chapters.text: Then, bang! A powerful strike, hard and low, past the keeper and into the net.

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Hit the ball hard and low. Keepers find low shots the hardest to stop, because they must dive all the way down.
